page_title: SEV 1-2 GET | Sevilla v Getafe 25/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+6' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle and it's Akor Adams (Sevilla) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+5' Substitution. Luis Milla makes his way off the pitch and Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
90+1' Akor Adams (Sevilla) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

88' Good chance for Peque (Sevilla) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
86' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Akor Adams (Sevilla) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
85' That's the end of the game for Juanlu Sanchez, who is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
85' Christantus Uche (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
81' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is stunned as referee Isidro Diaz shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
80' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
79' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' Mario Martin (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
72' Peque (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

71' OFF THE POST! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
70' The corner from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isaac Romero (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Chidera Ejuke can be given a rest.
66' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
62' Akor Adams (Sevilla) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.

62' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. It's a difficult effort to deal with and David Soria does well to punch it away.
59' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Vargas departs the field of play to be replaced by Peque (Sevilla).
57' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
53' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' 1 - 2 Adrian Liso (Getafe) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
50' Adrian Liso (Getafe) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
50' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Getafe will take a free kick near the side line.
47' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+7' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Christantus Uche (Getafe), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
45+6' A snap shot by Adrian Liso (Getafe) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Orjan Nyland produces a good save to thwart him.
45+3' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
44' The foul by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) was seen by Isidro Diaz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
42' The resulting corner from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
40' Akor Adams (Sevilla) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.

39' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Getafe.
38' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Adrian Liso (Getafe) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
32' A cooling break is underway.
31' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Orjan Nyland makes a save.
27' Adrian Liso (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
26' Adrian Liso (Getafe) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' The ball is cleared after Akor Adams (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Christantus Uche (Getafe) picks up a long through ball, but Orjan Nyland deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
22' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Sevilla manage to earn a corner.
21' Looks like Christantus Uche (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
18' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will take a throw-in.
15' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Adrian Liso (Getafe) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Luis Milla provided an assist for the goal.
15' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
12' Isidro Diaz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Christantus Uche (Getafe). Sevilla get a free kick.

10' Big chance! A simple pass from Dodi Lukebakio left Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
9' Christantus Uche (Getafe) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

8' Sevilla slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
4' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
4' Sevilla control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' Christantus Uche (Getafe) commits a foul and Isidro Diaz immediately signals a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Isidro Diaz.
